description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ViewQuickTest' that tests the behavior of the 'ViewQuick' class within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods to test instantiation and display functionality, setting up mock objects such as 'DetailView2', 'Sugar_Smarty', and 'BeanFactory'. The file is part of the unit tests for the MVC View components.

classes.name: ViewQuickTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the 'ViewQuick' class in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: testViewQuick
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of 'ViewQuick' and verifies it is an instance of 'ViewQuick' and 'ViewDetail', as well as checking the 'type' property and 'options' array.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the 'display' method flow by setting up 'DetailView2', 'Sugar_Smarty', and 'Bean' objects, calling 'setup', and ensuring no exceptions are thrown.

methods.description: Initial setup for the test case, creating a mock 'current_user' object.
